subject.title: Discord DMs: inbound messages silently dropped (outbound works)

question: Should Discord account-scoped allowFrom replace the root allowlist as the current docs/tests say, or should root and account allowFrom be unioned for inbound DMs?
rationale: The obvious fix changes who is authorized to start Discord DM agent sessions, so code inspection alone cannot choose the intended security contract.

options.title: Preserve account narrowing by default
options.body: Keep account-scoped allowFrom as a narrowing boundary unless maintainers add a documented migration or explicit opt-in broader behavior.

options.title: Union root and account allowFrom
options.body: Allow root-listed users through account DMs too, which addresses the proposed root-cause path but broadens access for accounts that were intentionally narrower.

options.title: Require explicit per-account DM allowlists
options.body: Treat the issue as diagnostics/docs plus setup validation and require users to put every allowed DM sender on the receiving account.

recommendation.title: Preserve account narrowing by default
recommendation.body: Keep account-scoped allowFrom as a narrowing boundary unless maintainers add a documented migration or explicit opt-in broader behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on shared account config and Discord DM access semantics where this owner has the strongest recent history.
